run_paralleldomain4d_conversion: run the paralleldomain4d conversion script to process all scenes from the raw dataset into WAI format
process_paralleldomain4d_scene: process a single Parallel Domain 4D scene into WAI format with symlinked images and EXR depth
convert_pose_lfu_to_rdf: convert a camera pose from LFU convention to OpenCV RDF convention using a rotation matrix
store_depth_as_exr: store a depth tensor as an EXR file using the store_data utility function
generate_scene_metadata: generate and store scene metadata JSON with frame info, intrinsics, and camera convention
